definitions.a: engine pig removal of the branch (#104 campaign branches.json pig_removed, #85 engine channel); model cost = the #111 tie-free primary at frame 225: pig presence - 0.1 x pig-slot centre displacement
definitions.b: at least 1 block entity destroyed (engine entity_destroyed) during the shot, i.e. fewer blocks survive than the level starts with; model cost at frame 225 = sum over the block slots of presence - 0.1 x sum over the block slots of centre displacement (the tie-free form on the blocks)
definitions.c: summed displacement of the dynamic blocks and the pig from frame 0 to their last present native step >= 0.5 world units; model cost at frame 225 = minus the summed block- and pig-slot centre displacement
definitions.d: engine collision event between the launched bird and a block or the pig at or before frame 150 (native step first_fixed_step + 50 x 150); model cost = minus the summed block- and pig-slot centre displacement at the rollout's last visited frame <= 150
